note: Review questions with the docs page and the fact a correct result must show. Written from recurring App Review finding types (Marketplace guidelines, submission checklist, review notes), not exported from Airtable rejection records. `pages` are path fragments of developers.webflow.com that hold the rule; `fact` is a case-insensitive regex the result text must match.
